name: darkest_maggot
comment: Maggot Lair 3 (src/patches/116_act2_tier3.py): a copy of three of the lair's own rooms in a line, no stairs: the hero arrives in the south room (magn) and goes north through one tunnel (magns) to the treasure room (mags), whose unique-chest spot holds the Staff of Kings' chest on this level. The rooms' own monsters are gone.
